problems: Frame 06 (minor): the laptop-screen insert sits right over Maya's face, and her bun and pencil stick up above it, so for a moment it looks like the laptop is her head. The dimmed background keeps it readable as a pop-up, but moving the insert higher or cutting fully to the screen would be cleaner.

Frame 06 (minor, not false): the script asked for Google's actual wording, but the screen shows a summary table ('no faster', 'days to weeks', 'URL Inspection') with developers.google.com as the source. All three points match Google's 'Ask Google to recrawl your URLs' page, so no claim is untrue.

Frames 02-03 (minor acting): Maya has a wide open-mouth grin while Floey tells her clicking won't help, and a big grin with both hands up on 'Says who?'. The script asks for her to freeze mid-click, then show flat disbelief. It reads as cheeky rather than doubtful, so a raised-eyebrow, flat-mouth face would land better.
Frame 08 (check): on 'Nothing.' Maya is frowning but not yet in the facepalm pose. If the facepalm and soft thud never happen later in this shot, the payoff loses its physical beat.

Frame 10 (minor): Maya has her arms crossed but her eyes are closed, while the script wants a 'caught' look at the camera. It still reads as sulking, so it works, but eyes on the camera would sell the button better.
